parameters.command:
=docker run --rm \
--network containers_net \
-v "{{ $env.OUTPUTS }}:/app/outputs" \
-e TARGET={{$node["Conf"].json.project}} \
-e RABBITMQ_HOST={{ $env.RABBITMQ_HOST }} \
-e RABBITMQ_USER={{ $env.RABBITMQ_USER }} \
-e RABBITMQ_PASSWORD={{ $env.RABBITMQ_PASSWORD }} \
-e DASHBOARD_ORG_EMBED_ID="{{ $env.DASHBOARD_ORG_EMBED_ID }}" \
-e DASHBOARD_REPO_EMBED_ID="{{ $env.DASHBOARD_REPO_EMBED_ID }}" \
-e SUPERSET_PUBLIC_DOMAIN="{{ $env.SUPERSET_PUBLIC_DOMAIN }}" \
soca-heavy:latest \
python -m soca_runner.genportal

=docker run --rm \
--network containers_net \
-v "{{ $env.OUTPUTS }}:/app/outputs" \
-e TARGET={{$node["Conf"].json.project}} \
-e GITHUB_TOKEN="{{ $env.GITHUB_API_TOKEN }}" \
soca-heavy:latest \
soca linkeddata-portal \
--metadata-dir "/app/outputs/soca/{{$node["Conf"].json.project}}/metadata" \
--tools-file "{{$node["Conf"].json.linkeddata_tools}}"
